dedupe_keys.name: north sumatra hospital disaster readiness and safety index survey

description: This workbook records disaster-readiness assessments for five hospitals in North Sumatra, Indonesia. Herlina J. El-Matury and collaborators use interviews, observations and document reviews structured by the Hospital Safety Index, covering structural safety, non-structural systems and emergency-management functions. The sites are in Deli Serdang district and Pematang Siantar city, with five staff informants at each hospital. Mendeley version 3 provides the Excel file free under CC BY 4.0. Coverage is these five facilities and the assessment campaign; exact fieldwork dates were not established here. Three hospitals are reported in index class B and two in class A. These classifications are screening assessments, not observed survival during a future disaster or numerical failure probabilities. This limitation matters when parameterising healthcare resilience simulations. case_study-caribbean-smart-hospitals offers related facility-resilience context. No workbook cells or staff responses were downloaded, and no building inspection, fragility fit or independent validation was performed.
